name: Scorpion God
description: Agent of Nicol Bolas who slew Rhonas with poison.

timeline.summary: Bolas imprisons and warps three gods to serve his interests during the Hour of Revelation.
timeline.quote: Three other gods were imprisoned and warped by Bolas to serve his interests during the Hour of Revelation.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God is killed during the Hour of Devastation.
timeline.quote: Killed during the Hour of Devastation.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Three sarcophagi along the Necropolis crack open and three insect-headed gods awaken.
timeline.quote: three enormous figures stepped forward from their slumber, awakened by the demon's spell.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas challenges the scorpion god, which charges him in silence.
timeline.quote: Without warning, the scorpion god charged toward Rhonas

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas hurls the scorpion god across the gate with a spell of vigor but it rises unharmed.
timeline.quote: the immortal went flying across the expanse

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas imbues his staff with poison and fells the scorpion god, which drops to its knees.
timeline.quote: venom powerful enough to slay most living things

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The scorpion god grapples Rhonas from behind and pierces his skull with its tail sting.
timeline.quote: the scorpion tail, arched over the god, piercing his own skull.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas names Nicol Bolas with his dying breath and recognizes the scorpion god as one of his corrupted brothers.
timeline.quote: This god was once one of the original eight

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: With his last strength, Rhonas curses the God-Pharaoh and hurls his staff, which his final spell turns into a serpent that wrestles the scorpion god.
timeline.quote: his final spell transforming the weapon into a living monstrous serpent

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The scorpion god tears the serpent in two and advances while the other two gods enter Naktamun.
timeline.quote: the other two gods crossed the threshold of the gate into the city of Naktamun.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Iput returns in tears and announces that the scorpion god killed Rhonas and means to kill them all.
timeline.quote: The scorpion god killed him. It means to kill them all.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra finds Kefnet and Oketra confronting the scorpion god, and Oketra tells her the gods are there to protect the mortals.
timeline.quote: We are here to protect you

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Kefnet and Oketra fight the scorpion god in tandem, and it grazes Kefnet's wing.
timeline.quote: They moved in tandem with one another

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra's arrow of white light blasts through the scorpion god's head and it crumbles to dust.
timeline.quote: The scorpion god's pursuit was halted by Oketra's arrow of white light exploding through his head.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The scorpion god reconstitutes itself from dust and stabs Kefnet through the forehead, killing him.
timeline.quote: the beautiful and brilliant Kefnet, God of Knowledge, was dead before he hit the ground.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra leaps between Tuya and the scorpion god and is impaled by its stinger while Gideon cries out.
timeline.quote: the scorpion god's stinger was lodged in Oketra's gut.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God and Locust God join in Bolas's plan; the Gatewatch, Hazoret, Samut and the faithful fight the Eternals.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch , Hazoret , Samut , and the remaining faithful fought to repel the crypt's unleashed legions

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God emerges from a sarcophagus and kills Rhonas with its tail.
timeline.quote: Yet the Scorpion God's tail struck with lethal force, and Rhonas fell in agony

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Glory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oketra dies facing the Scorpion God as Gideon witnesses; Kefnet falls too.
timeline.quote: When Oketra and Kefnet fell, the two surviving gods turned on each other

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Promise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru reunite and rally surviving initiates against the Scorpion God and the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Rallying as many surviving initiates as they could, they fought back against the Scorpion God and the Eternal horde.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The living bring down the Scorpion God by driving it onto an obelisk; Hazoret vows to stand by the mortals.
timeline.quote: the living managed to bring down the Scorpion God by driving it onto an obelisk

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret fights the Scorpion God and is severely wounded but weakens its armor so Samut and others can kill it.
timeline.quote: Hazoret managed to weaken its armor enough for Samut and the others to finish it off.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oketra is killed by the Scorpion God in the Hour of Promise after healing people of Naktamun.
timeline.quote: Oketra was killed by the Scorpion God

citation.text: "Oketra", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut's spark ignites when she saves Hazoret from the Scorpion God.
timeline.quote: Samut's planeswalker's spark ignited when she saved Hazoret from the Scorpion God

citation.text: "Samut", section "Samut's spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The survivors all feel the pain of a fourth god dying, and Samut tells them four gods are now dead.
timeline.quote: Four of our gods are now dead.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A sandstorm sweeps in as an injured Hazoret emerges pursued by the scorpion god.
timeline.quote: A scorpion's tail pierced through the haze

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret traps the scorpion god in a pillar of flame, but it keeps coming and poisons her arm, which she cauterizes and severs.
timeline.quote: Hazoret crouched, panting hard, blood seeping from the wound that had saved her life.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut leaps onto the scorpion god and cuts through its softened carapace while the survivors fight it.
timeline.quote: She smashed into the scorpion god's side, and her blades pierced its carapace

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A khenra warrior wields Rhonas's reforged staff to knock the scorpion god back toward Djeru's trap.
timeline.quote: A lone khenra stood, hoisting Rhonas's staff into the air

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru trips the scorpion god and Samut redirects its fall so an obelisk pierces its chest.
timeline.quote: an earth-shattering crunch echoed across the battlefield as the obelisk pierced the scorpion god's chest.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret finishes the scorpion god with her spear, freeing him as her brother from his dark form.
timeline.quote: the god reduced to cinders and ash.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God fights and kills Rhonas and locusts descend on Naktamun.
timeline.quote: The Scorpion God fights and kills Rhonas

citation.text: "Accounting of Hours", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Locust God destroys the Hekma and the Scorpion God kills Oketra and Kefnet.
timeline.quote: while The Scorpion God kills Oketra and Kefnet

citation.text: "Accounting of Hours", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret commands them to protect survivors; Djeru and Samut return and save Hazoret from the Scorpion God.
timeline.quote: they returned to the damaged city and were able to save Hazoret from her fight with the Scorpion God .

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Joining forces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret appeared, injured and pursued by the Scorpion God; the survivors battled it and Hazoret reduced the god to ash.
timeline.quote: Hazoret delivered the final blow, reducing the god to ash.

citation.text: "Haqikah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God kills Kefnet and Oketra during the Hour of Promise.
timeline.quote: Kefnet was killed by the Scorpion God , alongside Oketra

citation.text: "Kefnet", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God confronts Rhonas near the Luxa River in the Hour of Glory and slays him with poison.
timeline.quote: Rhonas fought bravely but was ultimately slain in combat by the Scorpion God's deadly poison

citation.text: "Rhonas", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A towering scorpion-headed god, one of the original eight, corrupted by Bolas, who awakens in the Necropolis and kills Rhonas.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

pages_say.description: A giant scorpion-headed god that killed Rhonas and kills Kefnet and Oketra, reforming itself from dust after Oketra beheads it.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

pages_say.description: God whose sting sends venom strong enough to poison blood, bone and spirit.
